film.title: The Graduate
S: Mr. McGuire has one word for Ben

Stir the mayo, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, Tabasco and a squeeze of lemon into a pink sauce. Divide the lettuce and avocado between 4 glasses. Pile on the prawns and spoon over the sauce. Dust with paprika and hang a lemon wedge on each glass.
Ben is just drifting here in the pool

Mix the crab with the creme fraiche, lemon zest, a squeeze of juice, dill and pepper. Cut the cucumbers into thick rounds and scoop a small hollow in each. Spoon in the crab. Top each with a few beads of roe.
M: Mr. Gladstone's room service steak Diane
Ben signs in at the Taft as Gladstone

Bake the potato chips with a little oil at 220C until crisp. Sear the seasoned steaks in the oil until done to your liking, then rest. Melt the butter and cook the shallots and mushrooms until golden. Add the brandy and let it bubble off, then stir in the mustard, Worcestershire and cream. Return the steaks with their juices, scatter with parsley and serve with the chips.
Ben and Elaine finally talk at a drive-in

Bake the fries at 220C until crisp. Shape the mince into 4 patties and season well. Grill over high heat, adding the cheese for the last minute. Build the toasted buns with sauce, lettuce, tomato, onion and patty, and serve with the fries.
W: Elaine runs out on her own wedding

Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time. Fold in the flour, vanilla and milk and split between 2 lined 20cm tins. Bake at 180C until springy, then cool. Whip the cream with the icing sugar, spread the curd and half the cream between the layers, and cover the top with the rest.
K: Mrs. Robinson pours Ben a drink
Put a large ice cube in each of 4 short glasses and pour over 60ml bourbon. Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.
film.T: This is Benjamin. He's a little worried about his future.
film.D: A new graduate drifts through a summer affair with his father's partner's wife, then falls for her daughter.
film.P: Serve the steak when Ben signs the Taft register as Gladstone.
